blockingLoop.evidence: Repeated 'Was the rinse aid empty or set low...' and 'Are the dishes coming out dry now' after the customer repeatedly said they had not yet filled it and asked whether to fill it.

rationale: The assistant never answered the customer's simple, repeated question about whether to fill the rinse aid and then run Eco 50. It re-asked questions already answered and asked about results of a test the customer had not run. It never explained that plastics stay wet, that Eco reduces drying, or that unloading immediately matters, so the customer ended up stuck and confused. It did avoid unsupported heater or engineer claims and recommended no part.
